report.title: tel: and sms: URI schemes not supported in links.
report.body: ### Check before submitting - [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate ### Describe the bug Markdown links using the `tel:` and `sms:` URI schemes do not render correctly. ### Steps to reproduce Write the following markdown in a memo: ``` [phone me](tel:+440000000000) ``` I'd expect this to render as something like: ``` phone me ``` But it renders as ``` phone me ``` The same bug also affects the `sms:` URI scheme. ### Memos version v0.31.0-rc.1 ### Additional context _No response_

steps: Open the memo editor on the home page
Type [phone me](tel:+440000000000) into the memo editor
Click the Save button to create the memo
Look at the rendered memo in the memo list
plan.expected: the rendered memo shows the text 'phone me' as a clickable link (styled as a hyperlink) that opens a dialer/tel prompt when clicked, rather than as plain unlinked text
plan.reported_actual: the link renders as an anchor without an href (phone me), so the tel: link is not functional; the same happens with sms: links
missing: assumed: the memo is saved and viewed in the normal rendered memo list on the home page
assumed: 'renders correctly' means the text 'phone me' appears as a clickable hyperlink
Does the sms: scheme need a separate check, and with what example number?
plan.summary: Markdown links with tel: and sms: URI schemes render as anchors without href
